responsibility: This definition module declares the LONGREAL-oriented elementary math interface for GNU Modula-2 and publishes constants such as pi and exp1. It belongs to the numeric runtime library layer and exposes square root, exponential, logarithmic, trigonometric, arctangent, and integer-part operations specifically for LONGREAL values, distinguishing it from the REAL-based MathLib0 module.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition half of the LMathLib0 pair: it only publishes the LONGREAL API surface and constants. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/LMathLib0.mod, it contains declarations only and no cbuiltin/libm bindings or executable implementations.
